name: rest-holds-export
js: const object=v.scene.getObjectByName('swap'),clip=object.__reactorClips.find(c=>c.name==="Lie Back Knees Apart");if(!clip)throw Error('Missing saved pose');const mixer=new THREE.AnimationMixer(object);mixer.clipAction(clip).play();mixer.setTime(.75);object.updateMatrixWorld(true);return {target:[0, 0.28, -0.05],savedClip:clip.name};
